mapper.sql: select a.activity_id, a.activity_no, a.name, a.location, a.capacity, a.duration_hours, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.signup_deadline, a.content, a.status, a.creator_id, a.creator_name, a.del_flag, a.create_time, a.update_time, (select count(1) from oa_volunteer_signup s where s.activity_id = a.activity_id) as signup_count, (select count(1) from oa_volunteer_signup s where s.activity_id = a.activity_id and s.audit_status = '1') as pass_count, (select count(1) from oa_volunteer_signup s where s.activity_id = a.activity_id and s.audit_status = '0') as pending_count, (select count(1) from oa_volunteer_signup s where s.activity_id = a.activity_id and s.audit_status = '2') as reject_count from oa_volunteer_activity a
mapper.select:
a.del_flag = '0'
and (a.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.location like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and a.start_time >= #{beginTime}
and a.start_time <= #{endTime}
and a.status = '0' and now() < a.start_time and now() <= a.signup_deadline
and a.status = '0' and a.start_time <= now() and now() <= a.end_time
and a.status = '0' and now() > a.end_time
and a.status = '1'
and a.status = '0' and now() < a.start_time and now() > a.signup_deadline
and 1 = 0
order by a.start_time desc, a.activity_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_volunteer_activity ( activity_no, name, location, capacity, duration_hours, start_time, end_time, signup_deadline, content, status, creator_id, creator_name, del_flag, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{activityNo}, #{name}, #{location}, #{capacity}, #{durationHours}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{signupDeadline}, #{content}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorName}, '0', sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update oa_volunteer_activity
name = #{name}, location = #{location}, capacity = #{capacity}, duration_hours = #{durationHours}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, signup_deadline = #{signupDeadline}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate()
where activity_id = #{activityId} and del_flag = '0'

update oa_volunteer_activity set del_flag = '1', update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and activity_id in
#{item}
mapper.select: select max(cast(substring(activity_no, 11) as unsigned)) from oa_volunteer_activity where activity_no like concat('VA', #{datePart}, '%')

select ifnull(sum(a.duration_hours * ifnull(s.pass_cnt, 0)), 0) as totalHours, ifnull(sum(ifnull(s.pass_cnt, 0)), 0) as participantCount, count(case when a.start_time <= now() then 1 end) as activityCount, round(ifnull(sum(case when a.start_time <= now() then a.duration_hours else 0 end) / nullif(count(case when a.start_time <= now() then 1 end), 0), 0), 1) as avgHours from oa_volunteer_activity a left join ( select activity_id, count(*) as pass_cnt from oa_volunteer_signup where audit_status = '1' group by activity_id ) s on s.activity_id = a.activity_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '0' and a.start_time >= #{beginTime} and a.start_time <= #{endTime}

select date_format(a.start_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(case when a.start_time <= now() then 1 end) as activityCount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(s.pass_cnt, 0)), 0) as passCount, ifnull(sum(a.duration_hours * ifnull(s.pass_cnt, 0)), 0) as totalHours from oa_volunteer_activity a left join ( select activity_id, count(*) as pass_cnt from oa_volunteer_signup where audit_status = '1' group by activity_id ) s on s.activity_id = a.activity_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '0' and a.start_time >= #{beginTime} and a.start_time <= #{endTime} group by date_format(a.start_time, '%Y-%m') order by month asc
